description:
Convert a Community database to ENTERPRISE on the SAME major (validated live 19 CE→EE). This is
    an EDITION change, not a version upgrade (for versions use upgrade_run). PREREQUISITE: place the
    licensed Enterprise .deb on the box at {ARTIFACT_DIR}/odoo_<major>e.deb (acquire_source enterprise).
    On confirm it backs up the DB (rollback), force-installs the Enterprise .deb (authoritative even if
    it sorts older than a CE nightly), installs `web_enterprise` to flip the DB to Enterprise, then
    validates + restarts. Idempotent: no-ops if already Enterprise. YOU must hold a valid Odoo Enterprise
    subscription for this database - pass subscription_confirmed=true to affirm it (Zoxron never supplies
    or validates the licence).
name: edition_upgrade
